questions.question: Explain botulism with reference to incubation period, clinical features, / and methods of prevention.
questions.solution_html:
• Botulism – Causative agent (Clostridium botulinum), incubation period (12–36 h), clinical features
  • (paralysis, blurred vision, respiratory failure), prevention (proper canning, boiling, hygiene).
